hyperedges.label: Badilag Brand & WCAG AA Accessibility Lock

nodes.label: Figma Checkpoint Rule
nodes.rationale: Stops public frontend implementation before starting so Master can prepare the Figma prototype via the Figma MCP desktop bridge.

nodes.label: Flux UI Free Tier Constraint
nodes.rationale: Restricts admin UI to Flux UI Free components and prohibits Flux Pro components such as flux:table and flux:editor without a license.

nodes.label: App Actions & Validation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates reusable business logic in app/Actions/ paired with Form Requests, Livewire validation attributes, and Policies.

nodes.label: SecurityHeadersMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Applies HTTP security headers and prevents personal data (NIP, birth date, private contact) from being exposed on public pages.

nodes.label: Visual Dials (Energy 1 / Rhythm 2 / Motion 1)
nodes.rationale: Establishes calm judicial authority (Energy 1), varied asymmetric section grids (Rhythm 2), and 150ms hover-only transitions respecting prefers-reduced-motion (Motion 1).

nodes.label: Primary Emerald (#056E4F)
nodes.rationale: Locked primary brand color per SK Dirjen Badilag Bab III.B.1 providing 6.27:1 WCAG AA contrast with white text.

nodes.label: Deep Emerald (#033D2C)
nodes.rationale: Used on top utility bar, footer, and hero scrim so light text achieves 11.77:1 WCAG AAA contrast.

nodes.label: Secondary Gold Accent (#FF9900)
nodes.rationale: Locked secondary accent per SK Badilag; paired strictly with dark ink #111827 (8.29:1 AAA) and prohibited with white text (2.14:1 FAIL).

nodes.label: High Contrast Accessibility Tokens
nodes.rationale: Maps surfaces to #000000 and foregrounds/borders to #FFFFFF or #FFFF00 for the accessibility widget high-contrast mode.

nodes.label: Typography Scale (Source Serif 4, Plus Jakarta Sans, IBM Plex Mono)
nodes.rationale: Pairs Source Serif 4 for institutional authority in headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for readable Indonesian prose and tabular UI, and IBM Plex Mono for SINOVA codes and system versions.
nodes.norm_label: typography scale (source serif 4, plus jakarta sans, ibm plex mono)

nodes.label: Flat Border & Constrained Radius Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Uses flat solid surfaces with 1px #D8E2DD borders so focus stays on primary actions, reserving shadows only for floating accessibility widget, active dropdowns, and confirmation modals.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Homepage Grid (8/4 Hero, 7/5 News)
nodes.rationale: Divides homepage focus with an 8/4 hero split (slider + <=2-click directory) and 7/5 news/announcements split to avoid monotonous uniform card rows.

nodes.label: Responsive Breakpoints & Touch Standards
nodes.rationale: Enforces zero horizontal overflow, >=44px touch targets on 390px mobile, tablet drawer collapse, and 1280px desktop container.

nodes.label: Embed Eksternal + Cadangan Manual UI Pattern
nodes.rationale: Displays live SIPP/SIMTEPA embeds alongside manual fallback content when external judicial sources are unreachable.
nodes.norm_label: embed eksternal + cadangan manual ui pattern

nodes.label: First-Install Multi-Step Setup Wizard
nodes.rationale: Bootstraps the Super Admin account and Satker metadata on first installation while locking court tier.

nodes.label: Fortify Mandatory 2FA TOTP & Login Hardening
nodes.rationale: Protects admin login via mandatory TOTP 2FA, recovery codes, 5/minute rate limit, local captcha, and configurable ADMIN_PATH prefix.

nodes.label: Laravel Boost AI Agent Tooling
nodes.rationale: Configures Boost MCP server, guidelines, and version-aligned skills so AI agents follow exact installed Laravel/Livewire/Flux/Pest APIs.

nodes.label: CI Quality Gate (Pest, Larastan Level 6, Pint)
nodes.norm_label: ci quality gate (pest, larastan level 6, pint)

nodes.label: SINOVA Evaluation System
nodes.rationale: Scores Religious Court websites across Content (60%), UI/UX (20%), and Performance & Security (20%).

nodes.label: Single-Satker Install & Tier Branching
nodes.rationale: Isolates each court in its own installation per Badilag server rules and branches seeded menus/criteria between Tingkat Pertama (PA/MS) and Tingkat Banding (PTA/MS Aceh) without deleting old content on tier change.

nodes.label: Six-Role RBAC (spatie/laravel-permission)
nodes.rationale: Separates operational permissions across super_admin, admin_konten, operator_kepaniteraan, operator_kesekretariatan, operator_ppid_humas, and read-only penilai_internal.

nodes.label: Database-Driven Menu Builder
nodes.rationale: Stores 3-level hierarchical menus in DB with criterion tags so future juknis revisions require zero code changes.

nodes.label: Structured Collections & Custom JSON Schema
nodes.rationale: Stores recurring SINOVA artifacts (performance, finance, LHKPN, dockets, surveys, staff) in fixed schemas rather than free text so completeness can be verified automatically.

nodes.label: Modul Kriteria SINOVA (Versioned JSON)
nodes.rationale: Models criteria_groups, criteria, and criterion_links seeded from juknis-2026.json with diff preview import while preserving existing filled links.

nodes.label: Link SINOVA Admin Page
nodes.rationale: Matches SINOVA form sequence with auto-resolved or manually overridden URLs, health badges, copy actions, and CSV/PDF export.

nodes.label: Scheduled Link Health Check & Simulation Score
nodes.rationale: Checks HTTP 200, non-empty content, current-year documents, and monthly stats via queued jobs to estimate SINOVA readiness.
nodes.norm_label: scheduled link health check & simulation score

nodes.label: Homepage Performance Guardrails (< 5s)
nodes.rationale: Enforces 3-5 compressed WebP/AVIF slides, mandatory alt text, blocks homepage video/live streaming, and applies full-page caching to hit LCP < 2.5s and Lighthouse >= 90.

nodes.label: Custom Accessibility Widget (2.b)
nodes.rationale: Avoids third-party overlays by using native Web Speech API (id-ID), high contrast, 200% zoom, dyslexia font, and semantic ARIA paired with /pernyataan-aksesibilitas.

nodes.label: Public /status-sistem Endpoint (3.a)
nodes.rationale: Resolves the conflict between hiding Server/X-Powered-By headers and proving non-EOL PHP/CMS versions for SINOVA 3.a via a dedicated /status-sistem page.

nodes.label: SIMTEPA & SIPP Generic Embed + Auto-Fallback
nodes.rationale: Supports Embed, Manual, and Auto source modes, switching automatically to manual backups when health checks fail while masking personal NIP/DOB/contacts.

nodes.label: Broken Link Crawler & Auto 301 Redirects (3.c)
nodes.rationale: Crawls internal/external links daily to detect 404/5xx errors and automatically registers 301 redirects when page slugs change.

nodes.label: Security Hardening & Offsite Backup
nodes.rationale: Combines local image captcha, HTML Purifier, out-of-webroot hashed uploads, activity logs, Nginx/Apache hardening, and weekly S3/Google Drive backups.

nodes.label: Git-Tag CLI Updater (cms:update)
nodes.rationale: Updates satker installations via php artisan cms:update (backup -> pull Git tag -> migrate -> clear cache -> health check) without risky web-triggered auto-updates.

nodes.label: Satker White-Label Template Variables
nodes.rationale: Replaces placeholders such as {{satker.nama}} and {{satker.kota}} across seeded content, SEO metadata, and footers from Setup data.
